redundancy_check.note: All final units were cross-checked for duplicate evaluation targets. Each material fact belongs to only one unit: vessel sales/cost impact (K9), economic/depa depreciation drivers (K3), dividend facts/impact (K5/K7), volumes (K2), financial performance (K1/K8), liquidity (K5), investments (K6), segment results (K4).

key_information_units.information: FY2025 headline financial performance: revenue decreased to EUR 765.3M (from EUR 785.8M in FY2024), EBITDA declined to EUR 130.1M (from EUR 175.2M), net profit fell to EUR 17.3M or EUR 0.023 per share (from EUR 40.3M).
FY2025 transported volumes decreased: passengers to 5,531,132 (-0.9%), cargo units to 245,004 (-19.2%), passenger vehicles to 760,473 (-2.2%).
Performance driven by economic uncertainty in Finland impacting demand and lower depreciation from aligning vessel useful lives to 45 years.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Letter from CEO; Management Report factors

key_information_units.information: Segment performance: Estonia-Finland route revenue increased EUR 1.7M to EUR 314.5M but segment result fell EUR 10.9M; Finland-Sweden routes revenue decreased EUR 3.3M to EUR 225.5M with segment result down EUR 1.5M; Estonia-Sweden routes revenue down EUR 12.1M to EUR 85.3M but segment result improved to loss of EUR 1.2M.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Sales and Results by Segments section

key_information_units.information: Liquidity position as at 31 Dec 2025: net debt EUR 432.4M (net debt/EBITDA 3.3), cash and cash equivalents EUR 13.5M, unused credit lines EUR 96.9M, total liquidity buffer EUR 110.4M.
Capital investments of EUR 33.0M in FY2025, mainly for maintenance and refurbishment of cruise ferries Baltic Princess and Silja Serenade, including technical upgrades, and IT systems improvement.
Dividends paid EUR 44.6M (EUR 0.06 per share) in 2025; Management Board proposed dividend of EUR 0.06 per share for 2026.
Q4 2025 results: passenger volume 1.3M (-0.3% YoY), revenue EUR 188.0M (+2.4% YoY), EBITDA EUR 27.6M (+7.3% YoY), net profit EUR 12.2M (vs net loss EUR 5.2M in Q4 2024).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Results of Fourth Quarter section; Key Figures

key_information_units.information: Fleet status: 11 vessels operated at year-end (2 shuttle, 6 passenger, 3 chartered out); sale of three vessels optimizing cost base; three vessels chartered out with extended agreements; shuttle vessels transitioning to biomethane fuel.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report vessel details; Letter from CEO on biomethane; Events section
